retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast, low-angle stage portrait featuring a vocalist with a microphone, characterized by dramatic top-down lighting and bold, outlined slab-serif display type in the upper corner.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, low-angle photograph of a male singer with long dark hair, eyes closed in expression, illuminated by a harsh overhead spotlight that creates deep shadows. The composition is anchored by a vertical microphone stand on the right and two lines of heavy, outlined slab-serif text in the top left.
coreVisualRelationships: The vertical microphone stand acts as a structural divider on the right third.
The overhead light source creates a strong highlight on the forehead and nose against a dark background.
The heavy typography balances the visual weight of the subject's head.
The subject's upward-tilted head creates a diagonal line of action.
coreInvariants: Heavy slab-serif display type with a thin white outline
Low-angle perspective looking up at the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located but slightly offset to the left, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightly lit face of the singer serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright face, follows the microphone stand upward, and then moves to the bold text in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space surrounds the subject, particularly in the upper right and background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark brown shadows in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and cool white highlights from the stage light.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: White for the typography and shirt details.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the spotlight highlights and the crushed blacks of the shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limited palette of black, white, and natural skin tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif with heavy rectangular serifs and consistent stroke weight.
letterConstructionRules: Thin white outline around solid white fill

treatment.outline: Thin white stroke with slight offset or double-line effect

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used for all text elements to maintain a bold, unified look.
graphicDevices: Thin white outline around the letters to separate them from the background.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serifs and geometric structure.
Provides the necessary blocky, vintage feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, low-angle photograph of a male singer with long hair, eyes closed, singing into a microphone. Use harsh overhead spotlighting to create deep shadows and bright highlights on the face. The background should be dark and out of focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of text in the top left corner using an extra-bold slab serif font in all caps. The text should be white with a thin white outline.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting coming from directly above?
Is the font a heavy slab serif?
Is the text positioned in the top left corner?
Is the microphone stand visible on the right side?

adjustableVariables: Hair length and texture of the subject
mustRedesign: Do not use modern digital filters; maintain a film-grain aesthetic.

mustAchieve: Strong vertical element from the microphone stand

postGenerationChecks: Check that the subject's eyes are closed or squinting to convey emotion.
Ensure the text outline is crisp and distinct.
Verify the low-angle perspective is maintained.
Confirm the background is sufficiently dark to make the subject pop.
recipe.reuseFormula: Dramatic Stage Portrait + Top-Down Spotlight + Top-Left Outlined Slab Serif Header
